findings.title: readGrid checks `row.length` but builds the grid from the row's iterator, so a crafted row passes validation with the wrong number of cells (minor, correctness)
findings.evidence: src/ui/capture-board.ts readGrid: `for (const row of value)` / `for (const cell of row)` replaced by index loops `for (let r = 0; r < n; r++)` with the per-row length check, so a replaced iterator no longer changes what is read. Red first in 5487adc; evidence docs/qa/add-capture-board/fix-round-1-check.txt, fix-round-1-green-run.txt. Mapping: dispositions["code defect (hostile value: an overridden Symbol.iterator, ...)"] "FIXED in fix round 1 (approved by the user)"; autonomy-log row 144.

findings.title: Validator accepts a structurally invalid grid via an overridden iterator, then mount throws (contradicts 'invalid value ignored silently, no uncaught error') (major, spec-compliance)
findings.evidence: Same fix: readGrid reads by index (an overridden iterator cannot smuggle a wrong-sized grid past validation) and readCaptureBoard wraps validate() in try/catch returning null, so mount falls back silently. Red 5487adc (5 red); fix-round-1-check.txt shows the fixed tests fail on the old loader and a try/catch-removed mutant is killed. Mapping: dispositions["code defect (hostile value ...)"]; test change explained in dispositions["test change inside the round"].

findings.title: A throwing getter or Proxy in the capture value escapes the mount as an uncaught error (minor, spec-compliance)
findings.evidence: src/ui/capture-board.ts readCaptureBoard: `try { return validate(value); } catch { return null; }` with the comment "A getter, a Proxy or a revoked Proxy inside the value may throw while it is read: that value is invalid too, and is ignored silently." Mapping: dispositions["code defect (hostile value ...)"]. The residual case (a getter on window itself) was confirmed by run 2 and fixed in 4b26246 (entries R2-F1, R2-F2).
